description: The mix, read by the page alone: how loud each family of sounds is heard against the others, and how the bed is made gentle. Each bus's level is in dB, under the player's slider; the sea bus is shelved down above shelf.frequency by shelf.gain dB. The master runs into a safety limiter (threshold dB, knee dB, ratio, attack and release s) that the mix is staged to keep away from. fades: s to fade in at the start, out on mute or hide, in on unmute or show, a slider's glide and the voices' glide (a time constant). bed: the sea's voices' levels as the recipes give them are played as most times (level / most) to the power curve, so a breeze and a gale are nearer than the recipes have them; trims are each voice's dB in the mix. calm: a quiet lapping at the hull while the boat drifts, its band (Hz, q) and level falling away over speed m/s, swelling every period s, each lap from rest to most. tone: the bow wave's hiss's band, Hz; the rigging sings only in gusts, from gust.from to gust.full of the wind's gust factor, its band's q; the gun's crack is low-passed at gunCrack Hz; birds' and colonies' harmonic calls are low-passed at birds.lowpass times their pitch and swell in over birds.attack s. noise: the seconds of each of the white, pink and brown noises the voices read, each at its own offset.
